newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's caretaker premier and cabinet sworn in.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's caretaker premier and cabinet sworn in.

text.p: Pakistani President Farooq Leghari swore in caretaker Prime Minister Meraj Khalid and a nine-member cabinet on Tuesday, replacing the sacked government of prime minister Benazir Bhutto, state-run television said.
Khalid, 80, and his nine colleagues swore their oaths of office in a ceremony at the presidential palace in Islamabad, television showed.
Leghari earlier dissolved parliament, sacked Bhutto's three-year-old government and named Khalid to head a caretaker administration to supervise general elections on February 3.

The television named the cabinet members as Sahibzada Yaqub Khan, Shahid Hamid, Shafqat Mahmood, Javaid Jabbar, Irshad Ahmed Haqqani, Omar Afridi, Sadiq Nawaz Awan, Syeda Abida Hussain and Muhammad Zubair, but did not give their portfolios.
The list is a mix of politicians and technocrats drawn from different political parties, including Bhutto's Pakistan People's Party and the main opposition Pakistan Muslim League.
